review_mode.description: Only `detail` in S5 (`queue` and `revise_and_apply` come with S6b).

matched.description: The label that matched (name, login, key or alias).

command_schema_versions.description: Command document versions this server accepts (§4.5).

validation.description: The check at creation: codes and statuses only.

evidence.description: Citations (`{citation_id, quote}`); checked for agent proposals (S6).

ops.description: 1–10 operations, applied in order, all or nothing.

preconditions.description: Exactly one per existing target issue, each with `lock_version`.

effects.description: One per issue the document touched.

CondInput.description: One condition on a custom field.

value.description:
eq/ne/lt/le/gt/ge: one value. in: an array. between: [min, max], inclusive, either may be null.
is_null/not_null: omit. Numbers for int/float, "YYYY-MM-DD" for date, true/false for bool,
the option label for list, "me"/login/name for user.

status.description: eventual (free text, index may lag) | not_applicable (SQL only).

changed_projects.description: Source projects whose settings changed since (the context can no longer be used).

source_projects.description: R: every project ever granted to this context, with the epoch recorded then.

type.description: int | float | date | string | text | list | user | bool | link

value.description: Number, "YYYY-MM-DD", string or bool; list: {id, label, active}; user: {id, name}.

policies.description: Modes inside the ceiling (§16.3); unlisted commands and fields are direct.

Done.description: An action that returns nothing but success.

ErrorBody.description: The error object of §4.3 (`{"error": …}` in REST, bare in MCP).

ErrorCode.description:
Stable error codes. Programs depend on these, never on `message`.
Codes of the §4.4 table arrive with the code that produces them.

oneOf.description:
Malformed request: bad JSON, unknown or missing fields, both a cookie
and a bearer token (`details.kind = "ambiguous_credentials"`).
No valid credentials, or the principal behind them is no longer active.
Login failed. Unknown login and wrong password look the same.
The action needs a recent step-up (password re-entry within 15 minutes).
Origin, CSRF token or Content-Type check failed.
Only a person in a browser session may do this (not an agent or a legacy key).
The target is visible but the caller may not do this to it.
Missing, or the caller may not know it exists (same shape for both).
A value in a write request is not allowed; `details.allowed`.
A read tool parameter has a bad value; `details.path`, `details.allowed`.
The custom field `filter` cannot be used (design 03 §3.7).
Tampered or foreign cursor.
A name matches several visible objects; `details.candidates`.

The agent's work context cannot be used: `details.kind` is
`"quarantined"` or `"closed"` (§4.4).
No usable delegation for this project.
Too many attempts; `retry_after_ms`.
Database or another dependency is down for a moment.
`lock_version` does not match; re-read and decide again.
A readable precondition field value does not match.
The same operation id was used with different content.
The same operation is still running.
The stored result of this operation id was purged; it is not run again.
A command or field the first slice does not support.
`exec_mode` other than `atomic`.
A required field is empty in the final state; only readable fields are named.
Workflow or field rules do not allow changing the field.
Not an allowed status; `details.allowed` lists the caller's transitions.
Duplicate of itself, or across projects.
The newly chosen version is locked or closed (§17.3 R1).
Deleting a version still used by issues the caller can see (R5).
A version with the same name exists in the project (R8).
Not the current version of the ChangeSet.
The proposal hash does not match, or the content was redacted.
What was reviewed is no longer what would run (§15.3, §15.4).
This version was applied already; `details.execution_id`.
Rejected, canceled or succeeded.
The delegator can no longer read the whole proposal.
The ChangeSet expired.
The write would reach readers outside every source project (§3.8).
An evidence citation did not verify as `valid` (§6.7 step 7).
A citation id cannot be decoded or has an unsupported kind (03 §3.7).
The quote is not what the cited range says (03 §3.6).
A proposal or write quota is used up (§8.9, §16.6).
The circuit breaker paused this agent work context (§16.6).
`q` has non-blank characters but no searchable term (design 03 §3.7).
The search index is broken or its worker stopped (not ordinary lag).

ErrorView.description: An error as the owner sees it on a failed execution or a validation.

search.description: Only when succeeded: the token from the domain transaction (§6.9).

editable.description: Can be changed (for agents: can be changed in a proposal).

reason.description: Why not editable: project_not_writable | not_editable | workflow_readonly.

required.description: Required in the current status (definition or workflow rule).

ops.description: create | update | transition: what the caller could do with the field.

options.description:
List fields: every option, inactive ones marked (they can be kept but
not newly chosen).

options_source.description: Where the valid values come from.

required.description:
The field definition itself is required (workflow rules are per status:
see the issue actions).

type.description:
string | text | date | principal_ref | priority_ref | status_ref | version_ref, or a
custom field type (int, float, date, string, text, list, user, bool, link).

or.description: At least one of these must hold.

FilterInput.description: Custom field filter: a condition, or `{"and": [...]}` / `{"or": [...]}` of filters.

Highlight.description: A highlighted range of a returned `text`, in code points, half-open.

Impact.description: What a date or status change touches, over visible issues only.

becomes_overdue_version.description: The version would turn `overdue` (it was not before).

due_after_new_date.description: Open issues whose due date is after the new version date.

IssueActions.description:
What the caller can do to one issue now (§5.2). There is deliberately no
`can_apply`.

IssueBrief.description: One line of an issue list (children of an issue).

allowed_statuses.description: Statuses the caller may move this issue to (workflow), current first.

custom_fields.description:
Custom fields that apply to this issue (tracker and project) and that the
caller may read, in display order; `value` is null when empty.

requested_key.description: Set when the requested key is an old key of a moved issue.

token.description: Shown once; only its hash is stored.

issue_id.description: The issue the op wrote (issue ops).

version_id.description: The milestone the op wrote (version ops).

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` with every non-GET request of this session.

MatchInfo.description: Which fields matched, recomputed from the current text (design 03 §3.4 step 6).

strength.description: primary: a full term matched; fallback: only single CJK characters or identifier parts.

NextAction.description:
What the caller may do next (contract 02 §14.2). A closed set; the list
on an error names options, not steps to run in order.

Op.description: `ne` also matches issues without a value; `lt`/`le`/`gt`/`ge`/`between` need an int, float or date field.

bind.description: A name later ops use as `{"type": "temp", "ref": …}`.

oneOf.description: `source` is the duplicate, `target` the original. Must be the only op.
§17.9a: agents only; the only op of its document.

bind.description: Accepted for symmetry with create_issue; nothing can refer to it.

oneOf.description: §17.9a: agents only; the only op, one precondition on the version.

PolicyInput.description: Per-command and per-field modes (§16.3). Keys must be inside the ceiling.

PolicyView.description:
A delegation's policies (§16.3) and what could be added (rule 1: commands
the server supports that the delegation lacks are never added by themselves).

available_commands.description: Operations the server supports that this delegation does not have.

field_values.description: Extra conditions on readable fields (normalized values).

allowed_values.description: Values the caller may give explicitly.

default.description: Used when `is_private` is not given (the tracker's default).

purpose.description:
`assignee`: only who an issue of `project` may be assigned to; more
than one match → `ambiguous_reference` with the visible candidates.

text.description: Name, login, project key or alias to look up (e.g. "缺陷", "alice", "AUTH").

valid_values.description: When nothing matched: valid values for the requested kind.

proposal.description: The complete new document (no deep merge, §8.8).

SearchEvidence.description: A snippet of the current text and its citation (design 03 §3.6).

evidence_status.description: current | rechecked (the index may still rank by older text; the snippet is from the current text).

highlights.description: Ranges of `text` in code points, half-open.

text.description: The cited text, verbatim: pass it unchanged as `quote`.

SearchItem.description: One search hit. Only the requested `fields` appear (and `key`).

custom_fields.description: Requested `cf:<name>` fields that apply to this issue and the caller may read.

lock_version.description: As re-checked in SQL (not the index): pass back as a precondition.

rank.description:
With `q`: position across pages (page 2 starts at limit + 1). Compare
rank and `match.strength`; there is no score.

assignee.description: "me", "none", a user login/name, or a group name.

explain.description:
With `q`: "none" (no snippets), "brief" (default: one ~60-character snippet per issue)
or "full" (up to two ~160-character snippets per matching field).

fields.description:
Fields per item: key, subject, project, tracker, status, status_category, assignee,
priority, is_private, created_at, updated_at, lock_version, cf:<custom field name>.
`key` is always returned. Default: key, subject, project, tracker, status,
status_category, assignee, is_private, updated_at.

filter.description:
Custom field filter, e.g. {"and": [{"field": "Severity", "op": "in", "value": ["High", "Critical"]},
{"field": "Estimate (h)", "op": "between", "value": [2, 8]}]}. Combined with the other filters by AND.

q.description: Free text (BM25 over subject and description; Chinese works without word segmentation).

SearchReceipt.description:
Design 03 §4.3: wait for this before expecting search to show the write.
Not a proof of commit; `status` is.

evidence_truncated.description: Some snippets were left out to keep the response small (the item list is still complete).

truncated.description:
Only with `q`: the server stopped after ranking 8000 candidates without
finding everything this page needs. More matches may exist (even if there
is no `next_cursor`); narrow `q` or the filters.

Strength.description:
`primary`: at least one full-weight term matched. `fallback`: only
low-weight terms (CJK unigrams inside a run, identifier segments).

oneOf.description: A milestone (update_version and its precondition only).

Thresholds.description:
The thresholds in use (org default or the project override); a null
value turns `deadline_near_incomplete` off.

TrackerSchema.description: Static schema of an issue in a project × tracker (§5.1).

schema_version.description: Changes when field definitions change: a hint, not a ticket.

blocked.description: A condition the caller cannot see blocks this transition.

then_readonly.description: Readable fields read-only after moving to this status.

then_required.description: Readable fields required after moving to this status.

checks.description:
structure, visibility, permissions, preconditions, workflow:
`passed`, `failed` or `not_checked`.

VersionFields.description:
A milestone's fields (§17.9a). Absent = not set; `effective_date: null`
clears the date. `status` only in `update_version`.

VersionSet.description: Absent = unchanged; `effective_date: null` clears the date.

VersionStats.description: Counts over the issues in the version that the caller can see.

no_dates.description: Neither a start nor a due date.

VersionView.description:
A version as §17.8 shows it. `deleted` versions are only returned by
`get`, never by lists or the next-version rule.

VersionWriteResult.description:
The result of a version write. A replay returns the version as it is now
with the stored `execution_id`, `changed` and `impact`.

changed.description: False when nothing differed (no event, no `lock_version` bump).

search.description: §6.9: every successful write carries the receipt (the original one on replay).

info.description: Browser-session API (contract 02 §4). Cookie only: a bearer token is always unauthenticated. Non-GET requests need Content-Type: application/json, the SPA Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Every response is Cache-Control: no-store.
info.title: oxledger SPA API

get.summary: Agent software that can be delegated to.
Own agents' work contexts, R and why a context is unusable.

post.summary: New work context (fresh_context_ack: true); closes the old one.
Stop this agent: close the context, revoke delegations and tokens.
New agent token (shown once).
Resume a paused context (needs a step-up; re-checks the context first).
Pause the agent's writes in this context (reads go on).
Revoke an agent token.
Sign in; sets the __Host-ox_session cookie.

get.summary: Login challenge; sets the __Host-ox_login cookie.

post.summary: End this session.
Step-up: re-enter the password.

get.summary: Current identity, CSRF token and capabilities.
Own sessions (no tokens).

delete.summary: End one of the own sessions.

get.summary: Your proposals, newest first (§8). Query bucket=awaiting_me (default: proposed or failed) or all; state.
A proposal: state, its current version, the last execution (owner only).

post.summary: Approve and apply a version (§8.6). Header Idempotency-Key. 200 with the execution (also when it failed); 202 with Location while the result is not known: resend the same request.
Cancel a proposal not yet applied. Header Idempotency-Key.
Reject the current version (final). Header Idempotency-Key.
Write a new version yourself within what the agent was allowed (§8.5). Header Idempotency-Key.
Check the current version now, without writing (§8.5).

get.summary: One version of a proposal (owner only).

post.summary: Run a command document now (human_direct, §6.8). Header Idempotency-Key: a uuid; resending it returns the same result.

get.summary: Own delegations.

post.summary: Delegate a project to an agent (creates its first work context if needed).

get.summary: A delegation's write policies (direct / review / off per command and field) and operations that could be added.

put.summary: Change modes or add commands / fields (needs a step-up; policy_version + 1).

post.summary: Revoke a delegation (only that project).

get.summary: An execution of your approval. Never starts anything.

post.summary: Find issues the caller can see (filters, custom field filter, free text).

get.summary: One issue by key, read from the database (not the index).
What the caller can do to this issue now: editable fields, transitions, notes, duplicate (describe, dynamic).
What one of your Idempotency-Keys did.
Users (and groups, when enabled) an issue in this project may be assigned to.
Fields, ops and creation rules of an issue in this project × tracker (describe, static).
Versions of a project (§17.8). Query status=open,locked (default), include=stats,next.

post.summary: Create a version (manage_versions). Header Idempotency-Key.
Name, login, key or alias to ids the caller can see.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a version (manage_versions, R5). Query lock_version; header Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: One version with stats and health over the issues you can see.

patch.summary: Change a version (manage_versions). Header Idempotency-Key; returns the impact of date or status changes.

get.summary: Version history, oldest first. Query cursor, limit.
Preview a change (manage_versions). Query effective_date (empty clears), status.
